title: orchis cordigera f. rochelii
intro: Orchis cordigera f. rochelii, commonly known as the Himalayan Orchid, is a plant species in the Orchidaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, digestive problems, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Orchis cordigera f. rochelii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
